facts.statement: Receiver Buffer is at address 0 width 8 read Receiver FIFO output
facts.quote: Receiver Buffer 0 8 R Receiver FIFO output

facts.statement: THR is at address 0 width 8 write Transmit FIFO input
Divisor access requires LCR DLAB set and blocks normal registers at 0 to 1
facts.quote:
The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set
to ‘1’. At this time the above registers at addresses 0-1 can’t be accessed.

facts.statement: Divisor LSB is at address 0 width 8 RW
facts.quote:
Divisor Latch Byte 1 (LSB) 0 8 RW The LSB of the divisor
latch

facts.statement: Divisor MSB is at address 1 width 8 RW
facts.quote:
Divisor Latch Byte 2 1 8 RW The MSB of the divisor
latch

facts.statement: WB_ADDR_I selects registers with 5 or 3 width
facts.quote: WB_ADDR_I 5 or 3 Input Used for register selection

facts.statement: WB_WE_I selects write or read cycle
facts.quote: WB_WE_I 1 Input Write or read cycle selection

facts.statement: WB_CYC_I indicates bus cycle in progress
facts.quote: WB_CYC_I 1 Input A bus cycle is in progress

facts.statement: WB_ACK_O is acknowledge of a transfer
facts.quote: WB_ACK_O 1 Output Acknowledge of a transfer

facts.statement: Divisor programming order is MSB first LSB next
facts.quote: Set the Divisor Latches, MSB first, LSB next.

facts.statement: Clearing LCR bit 7 disables divisor access
facts.quote: Set bit 7 of LCR to ‘0’ to disable access to Divisor Latches.

facts.statement: Setting LCR bit 7 allows divisor access
facts.quote:
Set bit 7 to ‘1’
to allow access to the Divisor Latches.
Also, in 32-bit data bus mode, the [ADR_I] is 5 and not 3 bits wide.
DATA_BUS_WIDTH_8 in uart_defines.v, uart_top.v or on the compiler/synthesizer tool

facts.statement: Core implements WISHBONE SoC bus interface
facts.quote:
The core implements the WISNBONE SoC bus interface for communication with the
system.

facts.statement: Core has 8-bit data bus for compatibility
facts.quote: It has an 8-bit data bus for compatibility reason.

Drive directed writes for DLAB 0 normal path at wb_adr_i 0 to 6 including THR path
Drive directed reads for DLAB 0 normal path at wb_adr_i 0 to 6 including Receiver Buffer path
Set DLAB via LCR then write divisor MSB at wb_adr_i 1 first per MSB-first set-then-clear order
Write divisor LSB at wb_adr_i 0 next then clear DLAB via LCR at wb_adr_i 3
Constrained-random top selecting among read write and DLAB-gated divisor children with DLAB constraint over wb_adr_i 0 to 6
